verdict.rationale: monday.com offers an official hosted MCP URL and a native integration for connecting agents. It also offers a separate developer MCP for scaffolding and promoting app versions from chat. A probe confirms a dedicated official MCP server docs page, and the integrations page names 'the monday MCP' for use with Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed evidence of the MCP tool coverage and auth flow beyond marketing snippets.
